title: TSPLIB instance catalogue
description: Instance catalogue consumed by `load_problems_config` (`ProblemConfig`). It is the single source of truth for optimal tour costs, replacing the hardcoded in-source optimal table (DP11-4, DP11-5).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

problems.description: Instances evaluated by the benchmark. Order is preserved when `problem_names` is not supplied.

name.description: TSPLIB instance stem used to resolve the database row and the `.tsp` file.

optimal.description: Canonical optimal tour cost from TSPLIB95; every gap is computed against it.

size.description: Number of cities (dimension) of the instance.
